notes: Stationary/probed observations of each true history use the same noise realization; pre-probe noisy frames must match exactly.
Fixed finite grid replay is a baseline, not a novel inverse algorithm.
True nonzero preload peaks are excluded from the candidate bank before data generation.
Synthetic Gaussian-center depth with declared synthetic noise, not calibrated consumer RGB-D.
Known small impulse is a fixed observation protocol, not a learned active probing policy.
Fit receives only the public observation bundle and prior settings. Future actions enter only after selection is sealed.
Acceptance thresholds are heuristics. Candidate forecast envelopes are not calibrated confidence intervals.
